lines.en: label convenience5:
scene norikobreak1
I show up at the convenience store to find it completely empty.
lines.zh: 我到了便利店，发现里面空无一人。

lines.en: I steal everything and go home.
lines.zh: 我把东西全偷走然后回家。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I do stand there for a mildly concerning amount of time, though.
lines.zh: 不过我确实在那儿站了挺久，久到有点令人担忧。

lines.en: Leaving the counter in a place like this unattended isn’t exactly a good move, especially considering I could reach over and open the register whenever I want.
lines.zh: 在这种地方把收银台丢下不管可不是什么高明的做法，尤其是我随时都能伸手过去把钱柜打开。

lines.en: Granted, there are probably cameras installed and I can’t imagine it would be particularly hard to identify someone who looks like me.
lines.zh: 当然，这里大概装了摄像头，而且我想认出我这张脸应该也不算太难。

lines.en: So I guess I’ll just keep waiting until Noriko shows up.
lines.zh: 所以我想我就继续等着，直到 Noriko 出现为止。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m done with this.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我受够这个了。

lines.en: I turn around to leave and-
lines.zh: 我转身准备离开，然后——

lines.en: : Psst!
scene norikobreak2
: Hi.
: Did you really just let me stand at the counter that entire time without saying anything?
lines.zh: : 你真的就让我在收银台前站了那么久，一句话都不说？

lines.en: : I was just admiring that you’re equally as cute from behind as you are from the front.
lines.zh: : 我只是在欣赏你从后面看和从前面看一样可爱。

lines.en: : Also, I thought you’d be smart enough to maybe look behind you once or twice before giving up and going home.
lines.zh: : 而且我还以为你够聪明，在放弃回家之前至少会回头看个一两次。

lines.en: : Always look forward, Noriko. Let this be your lesson for the day.
lines.zh: : 要永远向前看，Noriko。这就当你今天的教训吧。

lines.en: : What if somebody taps on my shoulder or something?
lines.zh: : 那要是有人拍我肩膀什么的怎么办？

lines.en: : Just keep on walking.
lines.zh: : 继续走就是了。

lines.en: : This sounds like bad advice.
lines.zh: : 这听起来像是糟糕的建议。

lines.en: : It's a lot more motivational without any follow-ups.
lines.zh: : 没有后续追问的话，励志多了。

lines.en: scene norikobreak3
: So...did you actually come here of your own volition today? Or did you just happen to wander in coincidentally again?
lines.zh: : 那么……你今天真的是自己主动来的？还是又碰巧逛进来的？

lines.en: : My appearance is very much intentional. I’m here to hang out with you.
lines.zh: : 我的出现绝对是有意为之。我是来陪你的。

lines.en: : Are you on break or something?
lines.zh: : 你在休息时间还是什么的？

lines.en: scene norikobreak4
: I’m pretty much always on break.
lines.zh: : 我基本上一直在休息。

lines.en: : People don’t like to walk around this neighborhood at night, so we’re dead for most of the hours that I'm here.
lines.zh: : 晚上没人愿意在这一带走动，所以我在这儿的大部分时间店里都没人。

lines.en: : You should see the place at like 3:00 AM. Total ghost town. Or...ghost store, I guess.
lines.zh: : 你该看看凌晨三点时的样子。完全是座鬼城。或者……鬼店，大概吧。

lines.en: : You don’t actually work that late do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会真的上到那么晚吧？

lines.en: : Not all the time, but I have in the past. Normally during summer or winter break, though. Just for extra money and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不是经常，但以前有过。一般是暑假或寒假的时候。就为了多赚点钱什么的。

lines.en: : I applaud your work ethic. I can barely handle the hours I put in at[school].
lines.zh: : 我敬佩你的职业精神。我在[school]的那点工时都快应付不过来了。

lines.en: scene norikobreak5
: I’m sure it’s really taxing for you to just show up and do nothing every day, huh?
lines.zh: : 对你来说每天只要露个面然后什么都不干，肯定特别辛苦吧？

lines.en: : You have no idea.
lines.zh: : 你根本想象不到。

lines.en: scene norikobreak2
: Well, hey. If you ever need any help around the class or anything, I’d be more than willing to lend a hand.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个。要是班里有什么需要帮忙的，我随时乐意搭把手。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ve got loads of clerical stuff piling up by now, right?
lines.zh: : 你肯定已经堆了一大堆文书工作了吧？

lines.en: : Oh, not really. The class rep normally handles all of that for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，其实没有。班长平时都替我处理了。

lines.en: : Is she in love with you too?
lines.zh: : 她也爱上你了吗？

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许吧？

lines.en: : Well that’s just fucking great.
lines.zh: : 那可真是太他妈棒了。

lines.en: : Or maybe not. I don’t know. Please don’t kill her.
lines.zh: : 也可能没有。我不知道。求你别杀她。

lines.en: scene norikobreak6
: I’m not going to kill her. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 我不会杀她的。只是……

lines.en: : More and more people keep getting in between us and I kind of want them to at least let me catch up first.
lines.zh: : 挤进我们之间的人越来越多了，我有点希望她们至少先让我追上来。

lines.en: : Like, I’m way behind in everything except for stuff that you can’t even remember yet.
lines.zh: : 比如说，除了那些你甚至都还记不起来的事，我在其他方面都落后太多了。

lines.en: : On the bright side, I’m giving you plenty of time to catch up with how much I’m starting to visit your workplace.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，我开始频繁光顾你工作的地方，也给了你足够的时间来适应。

lines.en: scene norikobreak7
: Yeah...But do you think that maybe you’d visit me more if I worked a little closer to the dorms?
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过你觉得，如果我在离宿舍近一点的地方工作，你是不是会多来看我？

lines.en: scene norikobreak8
: Oh! How do you think I would look as a maid?!
lines.zh: : 哦！你觉得我扮成女仆会是什么样子？！

lines.en: : Ami and that really short girl with the surprisingly large chest work there, right?!
lines.zh: : Ami 和那个个子很矮、胸部却意外地大的女孩在那儿工作，对吧？！

lines.en: : That seems easy enough. And a lot more exciting than sitting around eating prepackaged vegan sushi all night.
lines.zh: : 那看起来挺容易的。而且比整晚坐在这儿吃预包装的素食寿司刺激多了。

lines.en: : I’m actually not sure how you’d look in a maid uniform.
lines.zh: : 我还真不确定你穿上女仆装会是什么样。

lines.en: scene norikobreak9
: Because I’m not girly enough?
lines.zh: : 因为我不够女孩子气？

lines.en: : Yes. And no.
lines.zh: : 是。也不是。

lines.en: : I’ve just never seen you in anything girlier than your pajamas, so it’s hard for me to envision it.
lines.zh: : 我只是从没见过你穿比睡衣更有女人味的衣服，所以我很难想象出来。

lines.en: scene norikobreak10
: I can be girly!
lines.zh: : 我也可以很女孩子气！

lines.en: : Let me come over and try on Ami’s uniform. She’ll let me.
lines.zh: : 让我过去试穿 Ami 的制服吧。她会同意的。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : If she doesn’t, you can hold her down and I can run into her room and raid her closet.
lines.zh: : 如果她不肯，你就把她按住，我冲进她房间把衣柜洗劫一空。

lines.en: : I thought you didn’t like dressing like that? Because of...your expression or whatever it was.
lines.zh: : 我以为你不喜欢那样穿衣服呢？因为……你那个表情还是什么来着。

lines.en: scene norikobreak11
: Well it would obviously be different if it was for a job.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果是为了工作那当然不一样。

lines.en: : Maids are just personas those girls put on to trick gullible men like you into giving them all of your money.
lines.zh: : 女仆只是那些女孩戴上的一层人格面具，用来骗像你这样好骗的男人把钱全掏出来。

lines.en: : I can assure you that I am fully aware of how greatly I am taken advantage of inside that place. Gullibility has nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我非常清楚自己在那家店里被宰得有多惨。这跟好不好骗没关系。

lines.en: : The last thing I need is one more girl who’s able to peer into my soul that effectively.
lines.zh: : 我最不需要的，就是再多一个能那样看穿我灵魂的女孩。

lines.en: scene norikobreak12
: Are you sure about that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’ve told you before that I bring both the childhood friend trope {i}and{/i} the little sister trope to the table.
lines.zh: : 我之前跟你说过，我同时具备青梅竹马属性{i}和{/i}妹妹属性。

lines.en: scene norikobreak13
: Unless...Onii-chan just doesn’t want to see his sister in a dress because he’ll realize how quickly she’s growing up...
lines.zh: : 除非……欧尼酱只是不想看到自己的妹妹穿裙子，因为他会意识到她长得多快……

lines.en: : I’m not the same girl I used to be, Onii-chan. I have...feelings.
lines.zh: : 我已经不是从前那个小女孩了，欧尼酱。我有……感情。

lines.en: : I have...{i}needs{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我有……{i}需求{/i}。

lines.en: I look down to find that I am already reaching into my wallet for spare change.
lines.zh: 我低头一看，发现自己的手已经伸进钱包里掏零钱了。

lines.en: Damn all of these girls.
lines.zh: 这些女孩真该死。

lines.en: : As good as I think you’d be at the maid cafe, I don’t see a need for you to relocate just for me.
lines.zh: : 虽然我觉得你在女仆咖啡厅会干得很好，但我不觉得你需要为了我特意换地方工作。

lines.en: : Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko？

lines.en: scene norikobreak14
: Don’t you want to fulfill my needs, Onii-chan?...
lines.zh: : 你不想满足我的需求吗，欧尼酱？……

lines.en: scene norikobreak15
: Pfft!
: I can’t keep a straight face anymore, I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我绷不住了，抱歉。

lines.en: : You are...actually a pretty good actor.
lines.zh: : 你……其实演得还挺不错的。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. A good actor wouldn’t break out in laughter after delivering a line like that.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。好演员说完那种台词可不会笑场。

lines.en: scene norikobreak16
: Also...it’s not really acting.
lines.zh: : 而且……那也不全是演的。

lines.en: : I obviously think of you when...yeah.
lines.zh: : 很明显，我在……的时候会想到你。嗯。

lines.en: : But it is kind of embarrassing saying it out loud.
lines.zh: : 不过说出来还是有点难为情。

lines.en: : I feel like you’ve said much worse and gotten much less embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你说过比这过分得多的话，也没见你有多难为情。

lines.en: scene norikobreak17
: The mood someone is in when they say something greatly impacts the way in which it’s delivered, Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 一个人说话时的心情会极大地影响表达方式，欧尼酱。

lines.en: : If I’m turned on while I talk to you about being turned-on, I’ll probably be a lot more reserved than I would be if I was feeling totally normal.
lines.zh: : 如果我一边发情一边跟你聊我发情这件事，我大概会比完全正常的时候收敛得多。

lines.en: : Are you...actually turned on right now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在真的发情了吗？

lines.en: scene norikobreak18
: I think this “Onii-chan” thing might be a kink for me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得「欧尼酱」这个称呼可能是我的一个性癖。

lines.en: : The more I think about it...the more I...
lines.zh: : 我越想……就越……

lines.en: : Earth to Noriko.
lines.zh: : Noriko，回神了。

lines.en: scene norikobreak19
: Yes! Noriko! Me! Hi!
lines.zh: : 在！Noriko！我！嗨！

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Just trying to figure out how I should handle the horny version of you.
lines.zh: : 只是在想我该怎么应付发情版的你。

lines.en: : Why would you word it like that?! That’s just going to make it worse!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要那样说啊？！那只会让情况更糟！

lines.en: : Also, I...
lines.zh: : 而且，我……

lines.en: : You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: scene norikobreak20
: Job!
lines.zh: : 工作！

lines.en: : What kind of job?
lines.zh: : 什么工作？

lines.en: : Mouth!
: Please don’t call it a “mouthjob.”
lines.zh: : 求你别叫它「口活」。

lines.en: : I mean work job! Future! Plans! Help!
lines.zh: : 我是说工作啦！未来！计划！帮忙！

lines.en: scene norikobreak21
: I want you to help me think about stuff that doesn’t cause my innocent heart to crave less than innocent things.
lines.zh: : 我想让你帮我想点别的，别让我这颗纯洁的心渴求不那么纯洁的东西。

lines.en: : Especially while the rice balls are watching.
lines.zh: : 尤其是在饭团看着我们的时候。

lines.en: : Are we really back to that?
lines.zh: : 我们又绕回来了？

lines.en: : They are like children to me.
lines.zh: : 它们就像我的孩子一样。

lines.en: : Tiny, delicious Nakayarakawayamas.
lines.zh: : 一个个小小的、美味的 Nakayarakawayama。

lines.en: : I will destroy anyone who comes close to them.
lines.zh: : 谁敢靠近它们，我就毁了谁。

lines.en: : That will likely be bad for business.
lines.zh: : 那大概对生意不太好。

lines.en: scene norikobreak22
: Let’s just...talk more about other stuff I can do. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我们还是……多聊聊我还能做什么吧。好吗？

lines.en: : Like, I obviously can’t work at a convenience store forever. And if you choose someone else over me, I’ll need something solid to fall back on.
lines.zh: : 比如，我显然不可能一辈子在便利店打工。要是你最后选了别人而不是我，我也得有个稳妥的退路。

lines.en: : Preferably something where I’ll still have enough free time to dedicate to making you realize you made the wrong choice.
lines.zh: : 最好是一份还能留出足够空闲时间的工作，好让我专心让你意识到你选错了。

lines.en: : You’re not going to give up on me even if I wind up with someone else?
lines.zh: : 就算我最后和别人在一起，你也不会放弃我？

lines.en: : I am in...{i}way{/i} too deep to ever do something like that.
lines.zh: : 我陷得……{i}太{/i}深了，做不出那种事。

lines.en: : Nee-chan, too, probably.
lines.zh: : 姐姐大概也一样。

lines.en: : I guess our whole family is just naturally weak to you for some reason, Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 我想我们全家不知道为什么，天生就对你没辙，欧尼酱。

lines.en: scene norikobreak23
: Oh no! The horny! It’s back!
lines.zh: : 哦不！那股劲儿！又回来了！

lines.en: : There’s no way your whole family is weak to me. Like, what about your parents?
lines.zh: : 你们全家不可能都对我没辙吧。比如说，你父母呢？

lines.en: scene norikobreak24
: Thanks. The horny is gone again.
lines.zh: : 谢了。那股劲儿又没了。

lines.en: : I thought about you and my dad and that just...
lines.zh: : 我想到你和我爸，然后就……

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s just not doing it for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那对我完全不起作用。

lines.en: : I would have much preferred if you had used your mother in that fantasy.
lines.zh: : 我倒宁可你在那个幻想里用我妈。

lines.en: : But that could like...actually happen.
lines.zh: : 但那可是……真的有可能发生的事。

lines.en: : She loved you just as much as Nee-chan and I did. I don’t think it’s crazy to believe someone her age looked at [teenage]Sensei and thought “You know what? I’m down.”
lines.zh: : 她和姐姐、和我一样爱你。我觉得，相信她那个年纪的人看着[teenage]Sensei 会想「嗯，我愿意」，一点也不疯狂。

lines.en: : My dad, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我爸嘛……

lines.en: : Please stop bringing up your dad.
lines.zh: : 求你别再提你爸了。

lines.en: scene norikobreak25
: Oh my God! What if we actually started dating and you wanted to marry me, so like...
lines.zh: : 我的天啊！要是我们真的开始交往，而你想娶我，然后……

lines.en: : You went to my father to ask him for permission and he was just like...
lines.zh: : 你去找我父亲征求他的同意，然后他就像……

lines.en: scene norikobreak26
: You can have my daughter...but only {i}after{/i} I test your abilities as a man...
lines.zh: : 你可以娶我女儿……但得{i}先{/i}让我检验一下你作为男人的能力……

lines.en: : And then he’d ask you to take your pants off and-
lines.zh: : 然后他会让你把裤子脱了，然后——

lines.en: : Wow, would you look at the time? I think I have to get going.
lines.zh: : 哇，看看都几点了？我想我得走了。

lines.en: scene norikobreak25
: Wait, no! I promise I’ll stop fantasizing about you and my dad!
lines.zh: : 等等，别！我保证不再幻想你和我爸了！

lines.en: scene norikobreak27
: Oh, hi! I’ll be with you in just a sec!
lines.zh: : 哦，你好！我马上就来！

lines.en: : Okay! See you later!
lines.zh: : 好的！回头见！

lines.en: : She left.
lines.zh: : 她走了。

lines.en: : She did.
lines.zh: : 确实走了。

lines.en: : You should probably be careful about what you yell inside of a convenience store.
lines.zh: : 你大概该注意一下在便利店里喊些什么。

lines.en: scene norikobreak2
: Eh. It’s late. She knew what she was getting herself into when she walked in.
lines.zh: : 诶。都这么晚了。她走进来的时候就知道会遇上什么。

lines.en: : And now {i}she’s{/i} probably adding her dad to some sort of weird sexual fantasy and is going to blame us for it.
lines.zh: : 现在{i}她{/i}大概正把爸爸加进某种奇怪的性幻想里，而且还要怪到我们头上。

lines.en: : Look what we’ve done, Onii-
lines.zh: : 看看我们干了什么好事，欧尼——

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: scene norikobreak16
: I didn’t stop myself in time.
lines.zh: : 我没能及时刹住。

lines.en: : The horny returns.
lines.zh: : 那股劲儿又回来了。

lines.en: : I’m going to have to remember this for when it comes time to choose your lust name.
lines.zh: : 等到要给你选欲望名的时候，我得记住这件事。

lines.en: scene norikobreak2
: What’s a lust name? It sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 欲望名是什么？听起来挺好玩的。

lines.en: : It’s just a thing. I wouldn’t worry about it until later.
lines.zh: : 就是个东西而已。在那之前你不用担心。

lines.en: : Do I get to choose one too?
lines.zh: : 我也能选一个吗？

lines.en: : No. You stay out of this.
lines.zh: : 不行。你别插手。

lines.en: scene norikobreak10
: Mmm!
: You do that pouting thing a lot, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你经常这样撅嘴，对吧？

lines.en: : It helps me get what I want!
lines.zh: : 这样能帮我得到想要的东西！

lines.en: : Or at least it probably would if I didn’t have these “crazy eyes” people keep talking about!
lines.zh: : 或者至少，如果不是因为我有一双别人老挂在嘴边的「疯眼睛」，大概真的有用！

lines.en: : The failure rate of my pouting suddenly makes a lot more sense!
lines.zh: : 我撅嘴失败率这么高，突然就说得通了！

lines.en: : Then...stop?
lines.zh: : 那就……别撅了？

lines.en: : It’s muscle memory at this point! I can’t!
lines.zh: : 到现在已经成肌肉记忆了！我停不下来！

lines.en: scene norikobreak19
: Oh! I totally forgot to ask you something!
lines.zh: : 哦！我完全忘了问你一件事！

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: if brony == True:
: Is it true that you’re sexually attracted to those cartoon ponies from that one TV show?
lines.zh: : 你是不是真的对那部动画片里的小马有性冲动？

lines.en: : Did Kirin tell you this?
lines.zh: : 是 Kirin 告诉你的？

lines.en: : It just slipped out, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她只是不小心说漏嘴了。

lines.en: : How does something like that just slip out?
lines.zh: : 这种事怎么会不小心说漏嘴的？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but I {i}need{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但我{i}得{/i}搞清楚。

lines.en: : If you {i}need{/i} to know...then, yes.
lines.zh: : 既然你{i}非知道不可{/i}……那就是真的。

lines.en: : I am a proud brony. Tried and true.
lines.zh: : 我是个自豪的「马迷」。货真价实。

lines.en: : Do you have a favorite? I like the one with the hair that’s all like “whoooosh,” you know?
lines.zh: : 你有最喜欢的那匹吗？我喜欢那匹头发像「咻——」一样的，你知道吧？

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. Rainbow Dash.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。Rainbow Dash。

lines.en: : Yeah, her! Is she your favorite too?
lines.zh: : 对，就是她！她也是你最喜欢的吗？

lines.en: : My favorite pony is whichever one is on screen at the time.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的小马就是当时画面上出现的那匹。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were into them, too, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你也喜欢小马，Noriko。

lines.en: : Well...I definitely don’t get the urge to fuck them. But they’re totally cute.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我当然不会有想操它们的冲动。但它们真的很可爱。

lines.en: : Oh, and have you seen the human versions? They’re like, just as good.
lines.zh: : 哦，你看过拟人版的吗？那个也……一样好。

lines.en: : Oh. You’re one of {i}those{/i}...
lines.zh: : 哦。你是{i}那种{/i}人啊……

lines.en: : ...One of what?
lines.zh: : ……哪种人？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别在意。

lines.en: else:
: Have you ever played Raid: Shadow Legends before?
lines.zh: : 你以前玩过《Raid: Shadow Legends》吗？

lines.en: {i}Hi guys, it’s me! Selebus!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大家好，是我！Selebus！{/i}

lines.en: {i}I just wanted to take a second to tell you about-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我只想占用一点时间跟你们讲讲——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sike.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}骗你的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I had you going for a second though, didn’t I?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过我骗到你了那么一瞬间，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: scene norikobreak19
: Remember how I was talking about that one super smart girl who beat me in the standardized tests?
lines.zh: : 还记得我跟你说过那个在标准考试里赢了我的超聪明女孩吗？

lines.en: : Is there any chance she could move to our class, too?
lines.zh: : 她有没有可能也转到我们班来？

lines.en: : She was talking to me about it and apparently she’s already friends with that girl Futaba who sits by the window.
lines.zh: : 她跟我提过这事，而且她似乎已经和坐在窗边的那个叫 Futaba 的女孩是朋友了。

lines.en: Smart girl...friends with Futaba...
lines.zh: 聪明的女孩……和 Futaba 是朋友……

lines.en: : Is her name Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 她叫 Nodoka 吗？

lines.en: scene norikobreak2
: Yeah!
: She said that you two met before, but she wasn’t sure if you’d remember her or not.
lines.zh: : 她说你们以前见过面，但她不确定你还记不记得她。

lines.en: : I have a hard time forgetting girls who talk about seeing other girls naked. I remember her.
lines.zh: : 那些聊着看过别的女孩裸体的女孩，我很难忘掉。我记得她。

lines.en: : I see Kirin naked all the time now. She’s hot.
lines.zh: : 我现在天天都能看到 Kirin 的裸体。她很辣。

lines.en: : See? Like, I’m going to remember that for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 看吧？这种事我会记到天荒地老。

lines.en: : Boy brains are funny.
lines.zh: : 男孩子的脑子真有意思。

lines.en: : They’re not funny. They’re just simple.
lines.zh: : 不是有意思。只是简单。

lines.en: : Leave us alone.
lines.zh: : 别管我们。

lines.en: : Never~
lines.zh: : 才不要~

lines.en: : Anyway, I should probably start heading back.
lines.zh: : 总之，我大概该回去了。

lines.en: : I really only came over here to see how you were doing.
lines.zh: : 我过来真的只是想看看你过得怎么样。

lines.en: scene norikobreak22
: You didn’t need to do that...I know it’s a crazy far walk.
lines.zh: : 你不用特意跑这一趟……我知道这一路远得离谱。

lines.en: : I’m sure Kirin wouldn’t mind if you came over to the dorm to hang out really late, so just do that instead from now on and save yourself some steps.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定 Kirin 不会介意你很晚来宿舍找我们玩，所以以后就改成那样吧，还能省点脚力。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I like the idea of staying up that late just to come hang out in the dorm.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己喜不喜欢为了来宿舍逛逛就熬到那么晚。

lines.en: scene norikobreak5
: Okaaaaay~ But you’ll be missing a chance to cuddle with pajama Noriko.
lines.zh: : 好——吧~ 不过那样你就错过和穿着睡衣的 Noriko 抱抱的机会了。

lines.en: : Or pajama Kirin, I guess. But I’m less enthusiastic about you coming over at night to choose her over me.
lines.zh: : 或者穿着睡衣的 Kirin，大概。不过对于你晚上过来却是选她不选我，我就没那么积极了。

lines.en: : How about I just...keep doing what I normally do and hope it doesn’t become too annoying?
lines.zh: : 要不我就……继续像平常那样，希望别变得太烦人？

lines.en: : That’s fine, too, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概那样也行吧。

lines.en: : I’ll just go to sleep all alone, without my Onii-chan there to-
lines.zh: : 我就一个人孤零零地睡，没有我的欧尼酱在旁边——

lines.en: scene norikobreak15
: {i}Ahh~{/i}
: Why aren’t you stopping me from calling you that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不阻止我这么叫你？

lines.en: : Why would I ever stop something as awesome as this? Do it again.
lines.zh: : 这么棒的事我干嘛要阻止？再来一次。

lines.en: : Onii...
lines.zh: : 欧尼……

lines.en: : Mm~
scene black
I stay just long enough to watch Noriko squirm in her seat a few more times before deciding to buy a drink and heading back home.
lines.zh: 我又待了一会儿，看着 Noriko 在座位上扭捏了好几次，然后才决定买瓶饮料回家。

lines.en: She texts me for the next ten minutes or so as I make my way through the dark streets of the second half of town.
lines.zh: 在我穿过城里另外半边的黑暗街道时，她又给我发了大概十分钟的消息。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure she just wants to keep tabs on me so I don’t get mugged or something like that.
lines.zh: 我很确定她只是想盯着我，免得我被抢劫什么的。

lines.en: She’s a good girl.
lines.zh: 她是个好女孩。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: She still worries me from time to time.
lines.zh: 她仍然时不时让我担心。

lines.en: But at least her heart is in the right place-
lines.zh: 但至少她的心是好的——

lines.en: Tightly wrapped around my fingers.
lines.zh: 紧紧地缠在我的手指上。

lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!{/i}
